```text
For this guide, I have decided to create an extensive FAQ/Walkthrough. The
walkthrough is the main focus; it walks you through the whole game step-by-
step, leading you to the locations of all of the items in the game and
strategies for fighting the bosses. It will also be an extensive FAQ, which
includes lists of all of the items, equipment, skills, shop lists, a bestiary
with all of the enemies in the game, and more!
```

```text
                                 GAME CONTROLS
———————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————


   DEFAULT GAME CONTROLS
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
*Left analog stick - Move character/navigate menus
 Directional buttons - Move character/navigate menus
 CIRCLE button - Run (when using the Directional buttons to move)
 CROSS button - Confirm
 TRIANGLE button - Cancel
 SQUARE button - Display the Command Menu screen
 R1 or L1 button - Display the "Escape" command during battle
 START button - Start the game/skip cinematics

* = The Left analog stick gives you greater control of your character's
movement. If you press lightly in a direction, your character will walk. If you
press the Left analog stick all the way in a direction, your character will
run.


   MENU NAVIGATION
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
Shadow Hearts contains a number of menus. To navigate through a menu, highlight
your selection using the directional buttons or Left analog stick. Confirm your
choice by pressing the CROSS button. To go back to the previous screen, press
the TRIANGLE button.


                                THE STORY BEGINS
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
Rouen, France - 1913

A traveling English priest is brutally murdered on a rainy night. His only
daughter, believed to have been traveling with him, and his possessions have
vanished. She has been classified as "missing."

One month later...

A steam train blazes under the clear, starry sky. The train from Changchun is
headed for Dairen. Inside the Japanese army's luxury car, located in the back
of the train, sits the murdered priest's daughter. She has beautiful blonde
hair and eyes full of sorrow. Bored, she stares outside at the scenery.

An English gentleman approaches the girl. The next moment, a scream rips
through the train. One of the Japanese bodyguards is torn like a piece of paper
and falls to the ground. The English gentleman, smiling, locks his gaze onto
the girl.

"Who-who are you?!," the girl whimpers.
"I am Roger Bacon and I have come to take you away."

A great tragedy is about to begin...


                                PLAYING THE GAME
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
At the game's Title screen press the START button. Next, select from beginning
a New Game or Continuing a game (if you have saved data available on a Memory
Card (8MB) for PlayStation 2). When you have selected, press the CROSS button
to begin playing.

You can also adjust the Vibration Function of you DUALSHOCK 2 analog
controller. Select VIBRATION from the Main Menu and press the CROSS button.
Next, select from ON or OFF.


   SAVING AND LOADING GAME DATA
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
In order to save game data, you must use a Memory Card (8MB) for PlayStation 2.
Press the SQUARE button at a save point and select SAVE from the Command Menu
screen, under the "Data" column. Choose a Memory Card (8MB) for PlayStation 2
and a file to save to using the directional buttons. Confirm your save command
by pressing the CROSS button to complete the operation.

To load game data, select LOAD from the "Data" column of the Command Menu
screen. Select the file you want to load with the directional buttons and
confirm by pressing the CROSS button to load the saved file.


                               PLAYER ATTRIBUTES
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

   BASIC FIGHTING
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
Shadow Hearts is a game of myth, magic, and the macabre. As the story unfolds,
you will find yourself facing off against a variety of powerful and unearthly
enemies. In order to finish the game, you will have to rely not only on your
physical powers, but your supernatural powers as well. Shadow Hearts is a "turn
based" game. This means that when in battle, each character (or monster) on-
screen will get a chance (turn) to attack or defend. Each character thereafter
will receive their turn and so on. The battle will continue until one side has
won the fight.


   HP (HIT POINTS)
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
Each character (or monster) will have a number which represents their Hit
Points, which in turn, represents the amount of life in that character. When in
a battle, if a character (or monster) loses all of their HP, they will die.


   MP (MAGIC POINTS)
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
A player's ability to use magic is determined by Magic Points (MP). These
points allow for a player to cast spells (offensive and defensive) and perform
other magical feats. Once a player's MP runs out, they will lose their magical
powers.


   SP (SANITY POINTS)
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
Fighting monsters pushes one's mental state to its limit. Long battles affect
the mind as well as the body. The longer the battle, the more evil energy you
receive from the monsters. Characters with weak spirit can lose their sanity if
they receive too much evil energy. SP (Sanity Points) shows the mental strength
of a character and are displayed at the far right adjacent to HP and MP. When
this number reaches 0, the character loses his or her sanity and goes
"berserk." The main character also spends SP when they fuse with a monster. You
can tell by the large SP consumption that fusion is very hard on the spirit.


                                DURING A BATTLE
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
During the game, you will face countless enemies. These vile monsters come in
many forms, some weak while others strong. When you are attacked during the
game, the screen will flash and twist. After this happens, get ready to fight.
In order to win in battle, you must know what to do.

The camera will rotate and show you the enemies you will be facing. Take note
of which one you think may be the strongest or the weakest, as this may help
you in the upcoming battle. After each character (or monster) has been shown,
it is then time to begin the battle.


   STEP 1: THE ACTION MENU
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
The Action Menu is where you will make your decision on what to do in the
battle. Move the cursor next to the sub-menu you wish to access and then press
the CROSS button. To cancel your command, press the TRIANGLE button.


   ATTACK
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
This is your basic physical attack. After choosing to attack, you will choose
the enemy you want to target. Move the cursor over the desired enemy and press
the CROSS button to begin your move. After you have pressed the CROSS button,
you cannot cancel the command.


   FUSION (OR SECOND ITEM)
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
Use your Sanity Points to morph into a powerful beast. This "fusion" of man and
monster will cost you valuable Sanity Points, but will make your attacks even
stronger. After you have pressed the CROSS button, you will be able to select
the form you wish to take. Select one (there may be times when only one is
available) and press the CROSS button again to activate the fusion.

While FUSION is a power which Yuri possesses, this second item in the Action
Menu is unique for each character. For example, Alice's second item in the
Action Menu is WHITE MAGIC. Each usable character will have a specific action
they can perform, which gives way to even more actions.


   ITEM
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
Items are collected throughout the game and can be used for many different
reasons. Some are attack-based and others are defensive, such as healing an
injured character. After selecting an item, select the character on-screen that
you want to the item on and press the CROSS button. Remember that if you are
using a healing item (such as the Thera Leaf), use it on one of your
characters! You may just help an enemy without knowing it!


   DEFEND
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
If you choose to defend, your character's turn in battle will show them
covering themselves for an attack. Choosing to defend doesn't mean you won't
take damage, you just won't take as much as if you didn't defend yourself.

NOTE: When in battle, look at the bottom of the screen when you are choosing an
attack or defense. The text that appears will give you a description of what
the highlighted item/action does.

Now that you have learned about the Action Menu, it's time to learn about the
Judgment Ring...


                               THE JUDGMENT RING
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
The actions of each character (that you control) are determined by the Judgment
Ring. This powerful symbol reflects one's chances of performing a task, whether
it be as calculated as an attack or as simple as opening a gate. Either way,
when it comes to using the Judgment Ring, timing IS everything!

When it comes time to use the Judgment Ring, sections of the ring will be
highlighted. The object of using the Judgment Ring is to stop the cursor in the
highlighted areas by pressing the CROSS button. As the meter spins around the
ring, press the CROSS button as many times as there are highlighted areas to
complete your action. The closer you can get the meter to the outside edge of a
highlighted area, the better your action will be. This is very difficult to do,
but will be extremely useful in a fight. Also, if you are in a fight make sure
you check the meter in the first area, as this will give you at least one
attack. If you don't check the first area, you will not be able to launch an
attack.

The ring is different for each character and task. Make sure you know where to
check the meter based upon the task you are trying to accomplish. It's
difficult, but with a little practice you'll have no trouble.


                                THE COMMAND MENU
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
When you are not in battle, you can access the Command Menu by pressing the
SQUARE button. The Command Menu is packed with tons of information in case you
find yourself lost in the game. While it won't give you hints about what to do,
the Command Menu acts as an in-game instruction manual as well as an inventory
control menu that you will be able to use to your advantage.

You can navigate through the Command Menu by using the Left analog stick or
directional buttons to highlight items. Press the CROSS button to access the
item. Pay attention to the NOTE bar at the bottom of the screen. This will tell
you what each item does. Press the L1 button or R1 button to turn the pages of
the Command Menu.


                                 THE CHARACTERS
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

———————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————
   Yuri Hyuga             Age: 24            Class: Darkness
———————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————
Born in 1890 to a Japanese father and a Russian mother, Yuri's birthplace is
unknown. In his youth, he moved throughout China, going wherever his father's
military assignments took them. Both of his parents died when he was 10 years
old. Yuri's fusion ability awakened at the moment of their death and he has
been a harmonixer ever since. He is searching for the owner of a mysterious
voice, which guides him during this story.


———————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————
   Alice Elliot           Age: 20            Class: Light
———————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————
Raised in London, Alice began to hear supernatural voices at a young age and
became an exorcist, helping her father perform exorcisms. Now, people of
influence want to capture her and use her power for their own purposes. She is
shy and introverted at first, but her perky personality returns as she embarks
on her journey with Yuri.


———————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————
   Roger Bacon            Age: ?             Class: Darkness
———————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————
This mysterious English gentleman is hunting Alice for reasons not yet clear.
His good-natured facade belies a cruel personality. He is pure evil and uses
his powerful ancient magic to accomplish his sinister deeds.


———————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————
   Zhuzhen Liu            Age: Over 60       Class: Fire
———————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————
This wise sage is deft in the way of Yin and Yang and Feng Shui. He hints at
some past connection with Yuri and Bacon.


———————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————
   Margarete G. Zelle     Age: ?             Class: Water
———————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————
She is a world famous spy. She meets Yuri and Alice by chance and decides to
tag along on their journey.


———————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————
   Keith Valentine        Age: About 400     Class: Earth
———————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————
He is the lord of an eastern European castle. Bored of sleeping his life away
at the castle, Keith decides to join Yuri and Alice's journey.


                                    GLOSSARY
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

   The Graveyard
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
The Graveyard is the resting place of souls and plays a crucial role in Yuri's
special ability of fusion. He can swallow up monsters into his consciousness
and take their form to use their abilities. The ability to control a monster's
ability may seem convenient, but the user carries a risk of having their
consciousness being taken over by it. Yuri acquires his Fusion Monsters in the
graveyard. The tombstones begin to glow when Yuri defeats enough monsters to
accumulate sufficient Soul. Check the glowing tombstone - a monster of a
certain class will appear. Fight these monsters and defeat them to acquire
their form.


   Exorcist
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
Exorcists expel evil spirits from the possessed. Everywhere in the world, some
form of an exorcising ritual exists. As a Christian exorcist, Alice possesses
the power to perform this ritual. An exorcist also has the power to hear
supernatural voices. Alice can neutralize these voices and evil spirits with
White Magic. On the downside, others can use her power to summon a powerful,
evil spirit. The struggle to acquire her power brings on a great disaster.


   Malice
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
In any RPG (role-playing game), your ability rises as you defeat enemies. What,
then, happens to the souls of the defeated? Malice is the vengeance of monsters
killed in battle. By defeating monsters, Yuri earns the energy to raise his
abilities but he also earns malice energy. He must clear out the accumulated
malice at some point. The only place to clear the accumulated malice is in the
graveyard. One who can neutralize the vengeance of the slain is the true hero.


   The Reaper
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
When "Malice" accumulates beyond a certain capacity, the reaper appears. The
reaper assumes the form of the one Yuri fears the most and attacks him. The
defeated monsters' wish is to instill fear into Yuri's hearts - that is the
curse of the "masked monster." Will Yuri remain in fear of his worst enemy or
will he defeat it? Only you, the player can decide his fate.


   Yin & Yang and Feng Shui
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
The term Feng Shui originated in the ancient Chinese "Book of Burial." Its
philosophy is based on Five Material Agents. Yin and Tang and the Five Material
Agents are both Chinese universal explanatory principles. The essential
principle of Yin and Yang is that the universe consists of two opposing
elements, the Yin and the Yang. Heaven and earth, right and wrong, man and
woman, light and darkness - these opposing forces work to cancel each other out
and maintain balance. The Five Material Agents principle is based on the
principle that the universe consists of five materials: wood, fire, earth,
metal and water. There is also Ayurveda, which identifies earth, water, fire,
wind and sky as the five elements that make up the universe. Of the five,
earth, fire and sky represent the ground, the sun and the universe. Wind and
water chooses the "chi" emitted from these three spaces. This principle is said
to be the origin of Feng Shui. Shadow Hearts combines elements of Chinese sage
arts and western concepts of good and evil to make up a unique world of
mysticism.


  NOTE     If you need more detailed help, check the in-game Help section, or
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   refer to A-1-15 in the guide, which is the same as the in-game Help!
```

```text
After watching the greatest intro of video game history, head down to the next
train car. Go just a little bit further to enter into your first battle with a
couple of Wind Shears.

  NOTE     Shadow Hearts' battle system is very unique, actually requiring a
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   little bit of skill. Press the CROSS button within the highlighted
           areas on the Judgment Ring for successful attacks. Once you get used
           to the system more, feel free to try to time your attacks just right
           to succeed in more critical attacks in the smaller red area. If you
           miss though, you miss an attack completely.

Once you take out the Wind Shears, examine the body in the aisle for a
[_THERA LEAF_], then examine the body lying in the booth for a [_MANA LEAF_].
Head into the next car and proceed to the front, which will lead to more events
and a battle with Roger Bacon.

  NOTE     It's impossible to win this battle, so feel free to just wail away
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   at him, practicing your Judgment Ring until he uses Revelation to
           end the battle.

Watch some more events after the battle, then you'll be on the World Map. Feel
free to save out here if you like; you'll always be able to save your game on
the World Map. In any case, there's only one place to go: the Plains.
```

```text
After some dialogue, you'll regain control. Take a few steps to the upper-left
to find a [_PURE LEAF_] on the ground, then head down to the next area. Instead
of following the path, go right into the grass and to the next area, where
you'll find a chest containing a [_LEATHER BELT_]. Go ahead and equip this to
the Rude Hero. Head back and follow the path west until you find the girl. This
will allow you to continue the dialogue, where you'll be able to name your
characters. The default names are Yuri for the Rude Hero and Alice for the Girl
In Danger, and I will be referring to them by their default names throughout
the guide. Alice will join your party, and you'll regain control.

  NOTE     Alice comes equipped with a [_SMALL BIBLE_], a [_COTTON BLOUSE_],
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   and a [_BANDANNA_] by default, and also comes with the [_PENDANT_]
           valuable.

Start to head southeast and examine the body of water to your south. You can't
cross it yet, so take a few steps southeast. Before stepping on the bridge,
look just below where you're standing to find a [_MERMAID'S TEAR_]. Continue
southeast to the next area, where Alice notes that we need to do something with
the sluice gate to keep going, so that's our next task.

Before doing that, head north to the fork, then go east and past the fork here,
following the path as it turns north and west to another sluice gate. Examine
it to find out that you need a handle to use it. Now go back to the last fork
and use the Save Point to the southeast to save, that way if you accidentally
mess up the next task, you can reload and retry it. In any case, there are two
ways to handle this next task; read them both before deciding which one to try:

1) Examine the sparkling Sluice Gate handle at the bottom part of the screen.
   You'll have to do a "Push Ring" to be able to get the handle, meaning that
   you have to push the CROSS button several times in order to get the
   indicator within the allowed range, then press it intermittently to keep it
   in that area until the time expires. Doing this successfully the first time
   will not only net you the handle, but also a Leather Belt (raises Attack)
   here after a sequence of events. If you fail the first time, but succeed the
   second, you'll receive a Thera Seed, and if you succeed the third or any
   time after, you'll receive a Thera Leaf.

2) Examine the sparkling Sluice Gate handle at the top part of the screen.
   You'll have to do a "Normal Ring" to be able to get the handle, meaning that
   you have to push the CROSS button three times when the indicator is within
   the allowed ranges, just like in battle. Doing this successfully the first
   time will not only net you the handle, but also a Bandanna (raises Defense)
   here after a sequence of events. If you fail the first time, but succeed the
   second, you'll receive a Mana Seed, and if you succeed the third or any time
   after, you'll receive a Mana Leaf.

Regardless of how you decided to get it, you'll receive the
[_SLUICEGATEHANDLE_]. Head back to the northeastern side of this area and use
the SluiceGateHandle on the Sluice Gate to lower the water running through the
plain. Start to make your way back to the previous area, and they'll decide to
take a rest for a while. Shortly after Alice falls asleep, a mysterious figure
known as Fox Face will appear, and you'll have to fight him in battle.

  NOTE     Once again, it's impossible to win this battle, so feel free to just
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   wail away at him until he uses the !!! attack to reduce your HP to
           1, followed by being knocked out once again.

After the battle, you'll be in the Graveyard, the one in Yuri's dreams. When
you gain control, head north and examine the glowing green tombstone to be
thrown into a battle, this time with the Raging Tiger.

      .————————————.
     / * SUB-BOSS * \
.———'————————————————'——.———————————.——————————————.——————————————————————————.
| Raging Tiger          |    75 HP  | Class: Earth |                          |
|———————————————————————'———————————'——————————————'——————————————————————————|
|                                                                             |
|  Hey, we can win this one! Go ahead and use Yuri's Fusion skill to become   |
|  the Death Emperor, then use normal attacks to wipe out the Raging Tiger.   |
|  He's not tough at all, and should take just a couple turns to take out.    |
|                                                                             |
'—————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————'

By defeating him in battle, Yuri can now equip the soul of [_RAGING TIGER_],
Tigerion! Be sure to equip it in the menu. Next, head west and talk to the
Masks here, who'll tell you that you need to defeat the accumulation of Malice
within you to be able to leave the Graveyard. You'll then enter a battle with
Evil 4. He's pretty easy; just fuse into the Raging Tiger and dish out some
strong hits to take him out in a turn or two.

  NOTE     To sum up everything that the Masks have said: The Talisman Yuri
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   holds will show the level of Malice that has accumulated in his
           soul. To rid himself of the Malice, he must return to the Graveyard
           and fight an incarnate of his Malice to keep from having to face Fox
           Face in battle. Each enemy you defeat will increase the Malice
           Meter, so make sure that your Malice level (found in the menu) does
           NOT reach the red. If it does, IMMEDIATELY go to the Graveyard and
           fight your Malice so that you don't fight Fox Face. Right now, you
           WILL die if you try to fight him, so if you run into him, press the
           R1 button and choose to Run Away.

  NOTE     You also will now see the Soul Energy screen after battle. It shows
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   you how many points away you are from leveling up a class. Once a
           class is leveled, you can visit the Graveyard and obtain a new
           Fusion by examining the glowing gravestones (but only up to level 1
           Fusions for now; level 2 will be available later in the game.) If
           you're confused about how Malice and the Graveyard work, check out
           the Help section in the menu for a full explanation.

Once you're done with the Masks, head east and back out into the real world,
where Alice will rejoin and you'll regain control.

  NOTE     You can fight Evil 1, Evil 2, Evil 3, and even Evil 4 again by
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   returning to the Graveyard and fighting them when your Malice level
           is at a certain color:

           - Evil 1: Between Blue and Turquoise.
           - Evil 2: Between Turquoise and Green.
           - Evil 3: Between Green and Yellow.
           - Evil 4: Between Yellow and Red.
           - After each battle, you'll receive an item based on your Malice!

     .———————————.————————————————————.  .———————————.————————————————————.
     |  Malice   |  Prize             |——|  Malice   |  Prize             |
     |===========|====================|/\|===========|====================|
     |  01 - 03  |  Thera Leaf        |\/|  57 - 59  |  Pure Leaf         |
     |       04  |  Seal of Wisdom    |/\|       60  |  Seal of Speed     |
     |  05 - 06  |  Mana Leaf         |\/|  61 - 62  |  Thera Leaf        |
     |       07  |  Key to Success    |/\|       63  |  Seal of Power     |

     |  20 - 24  |  Pure Leaf         |/\|  71 - 73  |  Thera Leaf        |
     |       25  |  Seal of Vitality  |\/|  74 - 76  |  Mana Leaf         |
     |  26 - 29  |  Thera Leaf        |/\|       77  |  Seventh Key       |
     |  30 - 34  |  Mana Leaf         |\/|  78 - 79  |  Pure Leaf         |
     |       35  |  Silver Hand       |/\|  80 - 83  |  Thera Leaf        |
     |  36 - 39  |  Pure Leaf         |\/|       84  |  Seal of Aura      |
     |  40 - 41  |  Thera Leaf        |/\|  85 - 87  |  Mana Leaf         |
     |       42  |  Kirin Scale       |\/|  88 - 90  |  Pure Leaf         |
     |  43 - 44  |  Mana Leaf         |/\|       91  |  Monkey Paw        |
     |  45 - 49  |  Pure Leaf         |\/|  92 - 93  |  Thera Leaf        |
     |       50  |  Seal of the Soul  |/\|  94 - 97  |  Mana Leaf         |
     |  51 - 52  |  Thera Leaf        |\/|       98  |  Seal of Luck      |
     |  53 - 55  |  Mana Leaf         |/\|       99  |  Dice of Caesar    |
     |       56  |  Seal of Force     |\/|      100  |  N/A               |

  NOTE     The prize you win depends on the level of Malice you have
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   accumulated, with 100 being the max value. Sadly you can't use this
           knowledge to get the special prizes again and again, as they are
           replaced with a Thera Leaf the second time you clear the Malice at
           the same value.

  NOTE     The only issue with this is that it's a number the system tracks
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   that you cannot see. The levels change at 25/50/75/100, and the
           early monsters seem to contribute 1 point each toward the total, and
           it seems that as you go through the game, the stronger monsters give
           more points. It's something you kind of have to guess point values           as you go; it's more of a guideline than anything, since it just
           shows what's possible to get by doing so.

From the Save Point, make your way back to the screen with the bridge and the
river. There will be a chest here down below the bridge; open it to receive one
of the following:

   - A [_LEATHER BELT_] if you got the southern gate's handle the first try.
   - A [_THERA SEED_] if you got the southern gate's handle the second try.
   - A [_THERA LEAF_] if you got the southern gate's handle the third or more
     tries.
   - A [_BANDANNA_] if you got the northern gate's handle the first try.
   - A [_MANA SEED_] if you got the northern gate's handle the second try.
   - A [_THERA LEAF_] if you got the northern gate's handle the third or more
     tries.

Once you have your treasure, head back across the bridge, then cross the river
bank to the southwest and follow the path to the next area. Take a few steps to
the left for an event, then open the chest to your northwest when you regain
control for a [_HOLY MOTHER BUST_]. Continue to the village gates, where you'll
be able to enter after some short discussion.




_______________________________________________________________________________
```

```text
When you regain control, head back south to the first area of town, where
you'll find an [_ANGEL'S FEATHER_], roughly around the center of the area, just
to the lower-right of a pile of sticks. Go back up to the previous screen, then
follow along the right side until you see the '?' icon near another pile of
sticks. There is a [_BRONZE ARROWHEAD_] to be found here. Continue north to the
next area.

Use the Save Point here to save and clear Malice in the Graveyard if needed,
then check around the right side of the well here by a board on the ground to
find a [_TENT_]. Go all the way to the right, then all the way up; the corner
up here by the Lost Peddler/Wandering Merchant has a [_TALISMAN OF LUCK_] lying
on the ground.

Feel free to shop with the Wandering Merchant; I using your money for just
healing items for now, such as some Thera, Mana, and Pure Leaves, if you have
the extra money. Pure Leaves will really come in handy in the first part of the
game, where characters like Alice have hardly any SP and can't last in a long
battle without going Berserk. We'll be visiting another town soon, so we'll be
able to go shopping there with some more money. If you have some extra now, or
if the money's just burning a hole in your pocket, then buy some Leather Belts
and Bandannas so you have 3 each for your active party, and if you do, make
sure to equip both Yuri and Alice with both of them before continuing on.

When you're ready, head all the way north to the next area. Watch the events
here, then enter the house the children invite you to and continue watching the
events unfold. After some rest, you'll have to take on two Hellcats.

      .————————————.
     / * SUB-BOSS * \
.———'————————————————'——.———————————.——————————————.——————————————————————————.
| Hellcat               |    45 HP  | Class: Light | [_] TalismanOfLuck       |
| Hellcat               |    45 HP  | Class: Light | [_] TalismanOfLuck       |
|———————————————————————'———————————'——————————————'——————————————————————————|
|                                                                             |
|  They're not too bad; just have Yuri fuse into the Raging Tiger and wail    |
|  on them with regular attacks while Alice keeps both of you healed with     |
|  either Cure or Thera Leaves.                                               |
|                                                                             |
'——.—————————————————.——————————————————.—————————————————————————————————————'
    \   00040 EXP   / \   00300 Cash   /
     '—————————————'   '——————————————'

After the battle, head back into the house and examine the dresser at the very
top of the screen to find a [_PHOENIX TAIL_]. Go back outside, then make your
way north back to the shrine. After a scene with the Cat Lady, head back to the
previous area and make your way to the left side of the well, where you'll
encounter her again. Head south to the second area, where you'll run into her
yet again. Continue south back to the first area.

Here, you'll run into the Quack Oracle, who will introduce himself as the true
ruler of the nine heaves, the absolute sage Master Li Zhuzhen, referred to as
Zhuzhen from here on out. You'll also meet Wanderer Meiyuan the acupuncturist,
who's got a thing for Yuri, and would love to just stick his needles in him...
Zhuzhen will decide to help you out and will temporarily join your party!

  NOTE     Zhuzhen comes equipped with an [_OAK STAFF_] and a [_COTTON SHIRT_]
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   by default. As for Meiyuan, he can't fight, but his acupuncture
           allows you to increase the Attack Power of your weapon, the Hit Area
           on the Judgment Ring, or both. It costs a lot of money to do it at
           this point, so I don't recommend it. We'll be able to buy new
           weapons in the next town which will be stronger anyway. However, if
           you're having trouble hitting areas on the Judgment Ring, then by
           all means, try to increase the Hit Area if you can afford it.

  NOTE     If you want to see how much it would cost to power up your weapons,
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   check out section A-1-08 for the cost for every weapon in the game.

Once you regain control, continue north to run into the Cat Lady once again.
Afterward, head back to the center of town to run into her again, then go back
into the house you were lured into in the first place. After a scene here,
you'll learn that you need to find a Metal Vessel and a Torch to use with the
[_ANTI-CAT POWDER_] you receive from Zhuzhen to continue.

Head back outside, then make your way south to the second area. Here, follow
along the western side of the area until the '?' icon pops up, allowing you to
attempt a Normal Ring, just like in battle, to pick up the [_METAL BOWL_] we
were looking for.

Continue south to the entrance, then examine the building just to the right of
Meiyuan to find the [_TORCH_] among a pile of sticks. Now that we have both
items that we needed, make your way back to the center of town and use the Save
Point. When you're ready, enter the Cat Lady's house again and examine the pit
in the center. After an event, you'll have to fight her.

      .————————————.
     / * SUB-BOSS * \
.———'————————————————'——.———————————.——————————————.——————————————————————————.
| Felinus               |   250 HP  | Class: Wind  | [_] Lottery Ticket       |
|———————————————————————'———————————'——————————————'——————————————————————————|
|                                                                             |
|  This lady isn't to be taken lightly. She can use the Wind Fang ability to  |
|  hit everyone for Wind damage, and after a couple of turns, your whole      |
|  party will be in need of healing, so beware.                               |
|                                                                             |
|  Since she's a Wind class, have Yuri fuse into the Raging Tiger and use     |
|  the Flying Stones skill to do some decent damage to her, followed by       |
|  regular attack. Alice should be keeping everyone healed, as should         |
|  Zhuzhen. If no one needs healing then, have Zhuzhen use his Ogre           |
|  Flamedance spell, and Alice should attack normally. As long as you stay    |
|  healed and don't let Alice go Berserk, you should be fine.                 |
|                                                                             |
'——.—————————————————.——————————————————.—————————————————————————————————————'
    \   00120 EXP   / \   00600 Cash   /
     '—————————————'   '——————————————'

Once she's done, head back to the Save Point and use a Tent to recover your HP
and MP.

  NOTE     This next boss is REALLY tough if you're at a low level. I strongly
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   recommend fighting until everyone in your party is at least level 6
           before continuing on; it should only take a few battles. If you get
           some extra money, those Leather Belts and Bandannas for everyone
           would probably be a good idea.

When you're ready, head back north to the shrine and examine it. Do you dare
violate the shrine?

————————————————————————
   [1] No, I don't...
   [2] Yes, I do!
————————————————————————

the Lost Peddler on the second screen for a [_SNAKE CARD_], which is a Guild
Card that can be used for a discount in Shops.

That's it for Zhaoyang Village, so go ahead and make your way to the gate,
where Zhuzhen will leave your party. Afterward, head out to the World Map. Our
next destination is Fengtian!
```

```text
After a long series of events, you'll gain control inside the city of Fengtian.
Head over to the right side of the screen and talk to the Silent Peddler; he'll
give you the [_PEDOMETER_], which will count the steps you take when you have
it equipped. Later on, you'll be able to trade your 'steps' for prizes, so make
sure to ALWAYS have it equipped on an active party member; I put mine on Alice.

Go to the north side of the area behind the fountain until you see the '?'
icon. You'll find a [_TALISMANOFLUCK_] here. Next, head to the left side of the
fountain and talk to the man in green, the Building-Loving Man. Since you have
a Lottery Ticket from the Felinus battle, he'll offer to let you play the
Lottery! IGNORE him for now, as we'll be able to save here in a few moments so
that if we fail, we can reload and try again.

After talking to everyone, go back and talk to Alice to have her rejoin you.
Head west to the next area, then check the alley just to your upper-right to
find a chest containing a [_TENT_]. Approach the building to the left to have
the shopkeeper invite you in, then enter the shop for a scene.

Talk to the shopkeeper to learn about using your Guild Card that you acquired
earlier, which will allow you to get a 10% discount while shopping and a 5%
price rise when selling. As you can see, everything here is pretty expensive,
so you probably won't be able to buy much more than Yuri's and Alice's upgrades
for their weapons and armor. Make sure that you have some money left over to
have enough for a few Tents if needed, as well as necessary healing items.

  NOTE     I STRONGLY recommend saving before shopping. If you fail at the Ring
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   while trying to get discounts, you can always reload and try again.
           If you fail while not having enough money to purchase enough times,
           you can lose your card, so avoid it if at all possible.

Meiyuan is here as well, but I don't recommend using his acupuncture just yet;
it's too expensive for the bonus. When you're done shopping, attempt to leave;
Alice will ask if you're ready.

——————————————————————————
   [1] Just a bit more.
   [2] I'm ready.
——————————————————————————

Choose 2 to watch a series of events. Eventually, you'll regain control outside
in the alley. Check to your left to find another [_LOTTERY TICKET_], then go
back into the Item Shop and SAVE your game. The Building-loving Man is in here
now, and you'll be able to play the Lottery with him.

  NOTE     There are a very limited amount of Lottery Tickets in the game (30
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   to be exact), so (FOR NOW) I only recommend playing each person's
           lottery ONCE, and that is to get the item in RED. You MUST win a
           prize from each member's game once if you want to be able to
           participate in EVERY member's lottery, including the chairman's, so
           try not to miss any!

Make sure to win the Jade Lariat before continuing on; it widens your Hit Area
on your Ring, it's well worth it! If you don't win it, reload your last save
and try again.

Once you've done everything you want in Fengtian, go back out into the alley
and examine the ladder in the manhole to descend into the sewers.

  NOTE     At any point in the Sewers, if needed, you can return to the Item
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   Shop to save and/or shop.


   Sewers
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
Take a few steps to the right, then examine the stairs at the bottom of the
screen to find a [_GOLD HOURGLASS_]. Go back to the ladder and head north now,
taking the first left when you can. You'll eventually come to a chest, so open
it for a [_PURE SEED_], then go back to the last fork. Take the SECOND left
this time, and you'll come to a hole in the wall. After the scene, examine it
again to receive a [_LOTTERY TICKET_].

Head back to the fork once again to run into the Alluring Spy. This time,
she'll decide to join your party, and will introduce herself as Margarete.

  NOTE     Margarete comes equipped with a [_MINI-MAUSER_], and a
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   [_LEATHER SKIRT_] by default.

Make your way back to the ladder once more, then head east, north, and east to
an area with a Save Point. Use it if you like, then examine the ladder here for
an event. Afterward, continue west and you'll eventually come back to the chest
you passed earlier. Open it for a [_TYPE 94 PISTOL_] for Margarete; it
increases her P-Atk, but not her S-ATK, but I'd still equip it anyway.

Since you saw the event at the ladder, there's now one more item we need to
get. Make your way back to the first ladder you came down, then head all the
way north. The blast created some debris here, so cross it and examine the
glowing blue sphere in the wall to obtain the [_JEWEL_], which is the Sealing
Stone for the manhole cover. Once you have it, search just to the right of it
to find a [_ROSEWOOD BRACELET_].

Make your way back to the Save Point and save your game, then attempt to climb
the ladder; you'll be asked if you want to set the Sealing Stone.

—————————————————————————
   [1] Wait a moment.
   [2] Okay, it's set.
—————————————————————————

Make sure you're ready for battle, then choose 2 to face a sub-boss.
```

```text
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   temporarily leaving your party. Especially the Pedometer, if she has
           it.

When you gain control here in Dalian, head left and up the dock here to find a
chest containing a [_LOTTERY TICKET_]. Don't worry about the man guarding the
pen; we'll come back to him in a moment. Follow the path as it turns west, but
before going to the next screen, go up into the area that is partially fenced
in, and look between the two wooden structures near the edge of the screen to
find a [_TALISMANOFLUCK_]. Once you have it, go to the next area.

Use the Save Point here to Save, then go back to the previous area and talk to
the Man with Turtle. He's lost his turtle, and would like help finding it.

——————————————————————————————————————————
   [1] That's too bad.
   [2] I'll help if we trade something.
——————————————————————————————————————————

Choose option 2 to help him out. The turtle hides in a random place, so just
run around and press the CROSS button repeatedly until you find it. These are
the prizes you receive depending on how many tries it took you to find the
turtle:

 - 1-2 Attempts yield a [_LOTTERY TICKET_].
 - 3-4 Attempts yield a [_TALISMANOFLUCK_].
 - 5-6 Attempts yield a [_TENT_].
 - 7-8 Attempts yield a [_THERA LEAF_].

If you're not successful at getting a Lottery Ticket, just reload and try
again. He also says that if you come here again tomorrow, something good will
happen, so don't forget! Once you have your prize, head back to the center of
town. Go into the building on the upper-right, which is the Sea Turtle
Restaurant. Feel free to do some shopping here; I'd make sure you have plenty
of Thera, Mana, and Pure Leaves, and I'd upgrade your three Leather Belts to
Casual Belts and your three Bandannas for Leather Caps. While you're in here,
look behind the back table near the serving window to find a chest containing a
[_SILVER HOURGLASS_]. Head back out into the center of town.

  NOTE     The shop here sells both the Pirate and Brigand Earrings. The
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   Pirate Earrings increase your chances of getting an item after a
           battle, while the Brigand Earrings increase the amount of money you
           receive after the battle. You may want to buy some Brigand Earrings
           and equip them now, they'll pay for themselves in no time! Make a
           note that the effect does stack for each party member that also is
           wearing them, so make sure to have the whole party wear some when
           you need to grind for some cash! These can only be bought in Asia,
           so make sure to get some when you have the extra cash.

To your right you should see an old man standing underneath a wooden structure.
Search just his lower-right for a chest containing a [_TEAOFTHEHEALER_]. That's
it for items out here, so enter the building to the upper-left, which is the
Inn, for a scene. Once you regain control, head downstairs to visit the weapon
and armor shop. Before talking to the shopkeeper, follow the hallway to the
upper-right corner and examine the ground here to find a [_SEAL OF AURA_].

  NOTE     The Seals you receive throughout the game increase certain
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   statistics of the character it's used on. Normally, you only get the
           minimal increase if used outside of battle, but if you use it in
           battle, you have a chance of increasing it even more, so make sure
           to use them in battle.

You can't get the chest inside the shop yet, so go ahead and talk to the
shopkeeper if you want to buy something. Nothing is really needed at the
moment, so go ahead and head back up to the first floor. The people here are
now gone, so examine the boxes in the upper-left corner of the bedroom for a
[_TENT_]. Leave the Inn to see that the atmosphere has changed. Save your game,
and make sure once again that Alice has everything removed from her.

Take a few steps southeast to start a very long (and... odd) series of events
where Alice will temporarily leave your party, and Zhuzhen will rejoin! Note
that there are now monsters outside, and take the opportunity to visit both
shops here in town to upgrade Zhuzhen's equipment, as well as to stock up on
Thera and Mana Leaves if you didn't earlier, since your primary healer is
temporarily out of commission. 15+ Thera Leaves should cover it.

  NOTE     The next boss not only is very difficult, but he is also an Earth
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   class. By now, you should be very close to obtaining Yuri's level 1
           Wind Fusion, Tornado. The Water Creepers in Dalian are a Wind class,
           so fight enough battles with them until you are able to go to the
           Graveyard to challenge Tornado. Also, make sure that you are at
           least level 10 before challenging the next boss, or you'll have a
           pretty rough time against him.

  NOTE     You may also want to take the time to fight more of the Frog Gods to
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   build up your points for your Light Fusion. They come in groups of
           three, so it wouldn't take very long, and I recommend doing it. Just
           be careful not to get paralyzed.

Before doing anything else, PUT EVERYONE IN THE BACK ROW! Physical attacks are
useless against the next boss, so we might as well keep ourselves a little more
protected. When you're ready, make your way back to the screen with the dock
and the pen with the turtle. Head inside the pen and search the left side to
find a [_R.PHOENIX TALON_]. Once you have that, make your way to the dock and
examine the red sphere here to take on the next boss.

      .————————————.

|  replenish it so he can keep dishing out the damage. Have Margarete on      |
|  healing duty, using Thera Leaves on whoever needs them, as well as using   |
|  Mana Leaves on Yuri and Zhuzhen to keep their MP up. Have Zhuzhen use his  |
|  Ogre Flamedance continuously, stopping to heal if someone needs it.        |

¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   battle, as they will both be temporarily unavailable for battle in
           the next few events.

After the battle, make your way back to the Sea Turtle Restaurant to check on
Alice. After another long series of events, Alice will rejoin your party, and
you'll rest for the evening. When you regain control the next morning, make
your way back down to the basement of the Inn and take the path all the way
around into the equipment shop, where the little kid will finally let you have
his treasure, so open the chest here for a [_FLARE BROOCH_] for Yuri. Always
make sure he has this equipped; it reduces the amount of SP needed for his
Fusion!

Head outside, then go down and talk to the lady drying her fish. She'll give
you a [_SALT-DRIED FISH_] to give to Sea Mother. SAVE YOUR GAME, then go into
the Sea Turtle Restaurant and talk to her; she'll accept the fish and tell you,
"Where the turtle looks, take three steps." and you'll find a stash of money.
Leave the restaurant, then take, actually, about two and a half steps to the
lower-left to find the stash. To get all of the money here, you must hit all
three areas of the Ring.

 - Hitting one area will net you [_500 CASH_].
 - Hitting two areas will net you [_1000 CASH_]
 - Hitting all three areas will net you [_2000 CASH_].

If you don't get 2000, reload and try again. Once you're done here, go back
into the restaurant and talk to the man in green, Filthy Samo. He'll reveal
himself as Lottery Member No. 14!

           _________________________________________________________
           \$$$$ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ ¯ $$$$/
            \              [_LOTTERY MEMBER NO. 14_]              /
             \___________________________________________________/
              \¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯/
               \           (Red)  |  Pocket Watch              /
               /        (Yellow)  |  W.Tiger Hair              \
              /      (Turquoise)  |  TeaOfTheHealer             \
             /           (Green)  |  Pure Leaf                   \
            /            (White)  |  Tissues                      \
           /$$$$ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _|_ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ $$$$\

Make sure to win the Pocket Watch before continuing on; it gives the wearer
resistance to Judgment Ring anomalies in battle. If you don't win it, reload
your last save and try again. Remember, you need to win something from each
member at least once!

Save your game once again, then head over to the area with the dock and pen
once again. If you talk to the Man with Turtle once again, he'll offer to let
you play in his leaf field for 300 cash. You just have to take his hoe and dig
up three spots in the field, and anything you find becomes yours. With each dig
though, you'll have to complete a Normal Ring. Just like searching for the
turtle before, you can win prizes! They're not set like the previous game;
prizes include...

 - A Thera Leaf
 - A Mana Leaf
 - A Pure Leaf
 - A [_THIRD KEY_]!

The Third Key is worth getting, as it'll let you circle the Judgment Ring three
times in battle for a potential nine hits! There is only one here in the leaf
field, so once you find it, you won't find it again. Try to get it within the
first two times of playing the game, and if you don't get it, reload and try
again. If its battle effect has no interest to you, feel free to sell it for a
WHOPPING 15,000 cash! With a 5% price rise, you can sell it for 15,750! I think
you should sell it, to be quite honest!

There's also the Silent Peddler on the way to the dock. You can trade in some
of your steps for prizes if you want to, but I recommend saving them up until
you can get the best prize first, which happens to be someone's best armor at
10,000 steps.

That's it for Dalian, so on to our next destination! Go to the dock and talk to
the Courier Subordinate beside Margarete, who'll ask you if you're ready to go.
——————————————————————————————
   [1] No, not yet.
   [2] Yes, let's push off.
——————————————————————————————

Choose 2 to take off!
```

```text
When you gain control of a very queasy Yuri, open the chest on the left side of
the room for a [_ROSEWOOD BRACELET_]. Go up the stairs to the right for some
dialogue with Margarete, then go down and left, examining the door to the
wheelhouse for a scene. Afterward, head left a bit more, then check the top
barrel to the upper-right for a [_WITCH'S BROTH_]. Move left and talk to
Zhuzhen, then make your way back below deck to talk with Alice for a long
scene.

You'll regain control under the deck as just Yuri. Save your game, then go back
out on deck. Head inside the wheelhouse and take out the group of monsters
here. Afterward, before leaving, check the floor near the wheel and the blanket
hanging for a [_LOTTERY TICKET_]. Go back outside and downstairs to take out a
second group of enemies, and after they're finished, go back out on the deck
and talk to Zhuzhen to fight one last group.

  NOTE     It should be fairly easy to obtain both your level 1 Fire and Water
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   Fusions here, since the enemies come in groups of 3 and 4. I
           strongly recommend doing so, as it won't take long at all. Also,
           make sure Alice it at least level 11 so that she learns the
           Blessed Light spell.

Once they're done, and Zhuzhen is finished with the preparations, make your way
back down to below the deck and save your game. Before continuing, stop in the
wheelhouse once more and talk to the Courier Subordinate, who's asking if you
need anything in a strange way.

———————————————————————————————
   [1] Yes, of course.
   [2] What are you saying?!
———————————————————————————————

Choosing option 1 will allow you to see what items he has for sale. Make sure
that you have THREE Rosewood Bracelets to put on your active party, as the next
boss can paralyze you. Also make sure to have enough healing items.

Choosing option 2 will allow you to discover that he's actually a Lottery
Member!

easier to hit the areas! Make sure to win the Iron Clogs before continuing on;
it slows down the indicator speed on your Judgment Ring, but it also lowers
your Agl 15 points. If you don't win it, reload your last save and try again.
Remember, you need to win something from each member at least once!
```

```text
You'll have to watch a flashback from fifteen years ago first. After being
introduced to Yuri's overly-awesome father, Colonel Ben Hyuga, you'll have to
fight a battle as him. In the battle, feel free to fuse into the Czernobog and
use the Seventh Key item on one of the Kappas, and with you hitting as many of
the spots on the Judgment Ring as you can, watch as he obliterates both of the
Kappas and Wugui in a single round.

Afterward, you'll regain control as Zhuzhen in the Cypress Hotel in Shanghai.
The Silent Peddler is here beside your room, but again, I recommend saving your
points until you are able to get the best prize first. Use the Save Point on
the ground floor and feel free to talk to Margarete. Head out into the city.

From the entrance to the hotel, take a couple steps south and open the chest
for a [_PILGRIM'S STAFF_] for Zhuzhen; be sure to equip it to him. Make your
way out into the intersection in the street here. To your southeast is a man in
purple, standing on a red mat; search the ground beside the wagon with a barrel
just below that man (Hasty Kawa) for a [_LOTTERY TICKET_]. From there, go down
the nearby stairs to your south and examine the barrel at the very bottom of
the screen for a [_MANA SEED_].

Depending on how close you get to the stairs here to the west, you'll see an
event. This is where we're supposed to go next, but there are still some items
to be found first. Head back to the intersection and go east to the next area.

Go right, then follow the wall as you go south until you run across a '?' icon
at the yellow banner; check here for a [_TALISMANOFMERCY_]. Keep following
along the eastern wall until you come across another '?' icon near a long red
banner; check here for a [_B.DRAGON HORN_]. To your left from here is a blue
door; this is actually a shop (Mika's House), but save shopping here for just a
little later when we have another discount card. Continue southwest to the next
area.

Descend the stairs here, then examine the barrel next to the green archway for
a [_SEAL OF LIFE_]. Make your way south and down into the area below deck on
the boat. Talk to the boy here, and you'll find out that he's a Lottery Member!

     says that you receive it after winning it. However, if you check your
     inventory, you will receive a TeaOfTheSage instead.

The ring here moves REALLY fast, so remember, equipping the Pocket Watch will
make it easier to hit the areas! Make sure to win the Star Card before
continuing on; it allows you to get up to 20% off on your purchases, and 10%
more on your sales! If you don't win it, reload your last save and try again.
Remember, you need to win something from each member at least once!

When you're done, head back to the intersection near the hotel and go south at
the intersection, then down the stairs to your west for an event (if you
haven't seen it yet.) In the bar here, examine the barrel at the bottom-right
of the screen to find another [_LOTTERY TICKET_].

Talk to the man at the bar to start a series of events. You'll eventually have
two different battles against a Kappa each time. Just cast Ogre Flamedance and
heal, if necessary. After those two are finished, you'll take on Wugui, but to
no avail. You cannot win, so just defend and let him take you out with his Game
of Death. Once that battle is over, Yuri will step in and you'll have to take
him on once again.

|  strongest Soul, Raging Tiger, and just rip into Wugui with physical        |
|  attacks. He doesn't pose much of a threat, but if you let the battle go    |
|  on too long, make sure to heal.                                            |
|                                                                             |
'——.—————————————————.——————————————————.—————————————————————————————————————'
    \   01500 EXP   / \   04500 Cash   /
     '—————————————'   '——————————————'

Watch the long series of events afterward, and you'll regain control in the
hotel room. Before moving on, there's a couple more things we can do in
Shanghai. Save first.

At the intersection by the hotel, there's a stand just to your right before
going to the next screen. Talk to Lamenting Clerk Kuro; now that Wugui is gone,
you can buy weapons here, so make sure to upgrade!

For shopping recommendations, I recommend buying a decent amount of the new 2nd
level recovery items (Thera/Mana/Pure Seed and TalismanOfMercy), as well as
upgrading everyone's weapons, armor, and buying four (this time) each of the
Studded Caps and Western Belts, as all four party members will be participating
in the next dungeon.

  NOTE     Not only can you talk to Meiyuan in Zhen's Bar to have him do
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   Acupuncture, but he can also change out your party for you! Take
           advantage of that to equip your party as you like.

Once you're done shopping, make your way back to the bar, and examine the
curtain on the top part of the room. Mr. Zhen is now hosting pit fights! Right
now, you won't make it very far before you're killed, but you're welcome to
try! We'll come back to this after a while, when we're a lot stronger and are
able to finish it, but just know that it's here.

When you're ready, go to the intersection near the hotel and head north out to
the World Map. Make your way over to the Temple Ruins next.
```

```text
Make your way into the Temple itself after a bit of dialogue. Move forward to
the stage area in the center, but before examining the statue, check around the
left pillar to find a chest containing a [_LOTTERY TICKET_]. Afterward, examine
the statue to have Zhuzhen try to remember the rites to unlock the temple's
entrance. Make your way west to the next area, then continue along to find a
Save Point and a chest; open the chest for a [_TALISMANOFMERCY_]. Use the Save
Point, and talk both the Smuggler Boss, as well as the Courier Subordinate, who
you can do some shopping with, if needed. After doing that, go back and talk to
Zhuzhen to continue.

  NOTE     The Courier Subordinate has Leonardo's Bears for sale. You will find
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   two here in the dungeon, but make ABSOLUTELY SURE that you buy one
           more for your active party, as the last boss here WILL use
           Instant Death attacks.

Zhuzhen will unlock the passage, so go down the stairs to the next area. Follow
the path and you'll arrive in a small room with a Save Point and two doors.
After some dialogue, your party will be split into two groups; Yuri and
Zhuzhen, and Alice and Margarete. Your items will also be sealed in battle, so
make sure to do any healing outside of battle.

  NOTE     Xiaofang has a shop as well. As I mentioned before, make sure to buy
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   an additional Leonardo's Bear if you haven't already.

  NOTE     CLEAR YOUR MALICE BEFORE STARTING.

Warp Point; press the CROSS button to warp to another area. Move east to the
next screen, then east to another, where you'll find an empty treasure chest.
Keep going to the next screen, where you'll be at a fork in the path with a
chest containing a [_BRONZE ARROWHEAD_] inside. Ignore the north and east paths
since they lead to each other, then take the western path to a yellow Warp
Point, using it to warp to the next section of the maze.

Xiaofang is here this time, so feel free to buy some items if you like, then
head north to the next area. Continue north to an empty chest, then keep right
on going to the next screen. There'll be a full chest here this time, so grab
the [_TEAOFTHEHEALER_] out of it and keep going. At the fork here, take the top
eastern path first, where you'll find a [_W.TIGER HAIR_]. Back at the fork,
north leads to a dead-end, so take the lower western path to find yet another
chest, this time with a [_BRONZE DAGGER_].

Make your way south to the next area, opening an empty chest in this area.
Continue west to the next area to another fork. Head south first, opening the
chest here for a whole lot of NOTHING, then head south to the next screen for a
[_TALISMANOFMERCY_]. Ignore the path to the west and head back to the last
fork, taking the north path to the next screen.

Open the chest here for a [_MANA SEED_], then take the western path from this
room to find a [_BELL BRACELET_], which you should immediately equip to
Zhuzhen. Go back to the fork one last time and head north to the next screen.
If you like, head one screen east and open the empty chest here, otherwise,
ignore that entire direction, as it leads to the last area I had you ignore.
Head west to the next area, then north at the fork here (since south is a dead-
end), and you'll finally come across a red Warp Point that'll take you to the
next section of the maze.

  NOTE     Make sure that Zhuzhen is at least level 12 and has the
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   NourishingPotion spell learned so that he has healing capabilities.

a room. Use the Save Point, then examine the altar to find a glowing gem. Do
you wish to put your hand in front of it?

|  As with Wugui, Yamaraja: War will absorb all magic, making Zhuzhen useful  |

|  don't have those Leonardo's Bears equipped to everyone, they'll have a     |
|  chance to instantly kill you. His Nightmare attack will hit the entire     |
|  party for a lot of damage, so make sure heal afterward. The only other     |
|  thing he does is a hellacious physical attack that'll hit for major        |
|  damage. Once he starts using Nightmare repeatedly, you could be in a bit   |
|  of trouble.                                                                |
|                                                                             |
|  Have Yuri fuse into Inferno and cast Fighting Spirit on himself, followed  |
|  by physically attacking Yamaraja every turn. Margarete should be           |
|  attacking normally, but having her jump in to use Thera Seeds if needed,   |
|  and Zhuzhen should focus completely on recovery.                           |
|                                                                             |
|  If you're having trouble staying healed, have Yuri fuse into Heaven's      |
|  Fiend so you have the whole party healing spell.                           |
|                                                                             |
```

```text
At the intersection near the hotel, head east to the next section. Head south
toward the dock, but stop at the fork with the shop at Mika's House. Go
southeast and enter the building that was previously locked. There's nothing
too terribly important here, but if you check the cabinet at the top of the
screen that a bird cage is sitting on, you can get a [_TEAOFTHEHEALER_].

Make your way to the dock now where you'll find several dogs, along with the
Man with Dog. Talk to him to play a game: Shanghai's famous dog-picking
contest! Pay him 300 Cash, and you'll be able to play. Pick a dog, then it'll
move around, and you'll have to pick him again when you're done. It's basically
a glorified cup game. Here are your prizes for winning.

 - First win (three dogs) - A [_LOTTERY TICKET_]!
 - Second win (four dogs) - A [_LEONARDO'S BEAR_]!
 - Third win (four dogs) - A [_MONKEY PAW_]!

That's it for treasure in Shanghai. Now, you can either continue with Kuihai
Tower, or you can take on a couple of side quests! If you don't care about the
side quests, then continue on to W-1-11 - Kuihai Tower. Otherwise, read below!
```

```text
By now, you most likely have all of the level 1 Fusions for Yuri. If you don't,
I STRONGLY recommend getting them now. Heck, if you feel like it, feel free to
level them up to level 2, even though you won't be able to get any level 2
Fusions until a little later on.

Even though the Temple Ruins "collapsed", for some reason you can still go back
and go through all three of the mazes. As I mentioned before, the three areas
of the Temple Ruins hold an enemy of each class.

 - If you're needing the Fire or Wind Fusions, then go through the western door
   in the first room of the maze and fight in that area.

 - If you're needing the Light Fusion or want some more Dark Soul Energy, then
   go through the eastern door in the first room of the maze and fight in that
   area.

 - If you're needing the Water Fusion or want some more Earth Soul Energy, then
   you'll need to proceed all the way through the first western maze until you
   reach the second one. You can fight the enemies in here for those classes.

 - If you're wanting to grind for levels while doing this and want a challenge,
   then you may want to go to the Kowloon Fortress. It also has an enemy of
   each class, but they don't come in groups like they do at the Temple Ruins.
   They are also harder, so it's up to you.

Once you have enough Soul Energy to unlock the Fusions, visit the Graveyard and
take each one on, one at a time.
```

```text
The ring here moves REALLY fast. Normally, equipping the Pocket Watch would
make it run normally, but it has no effect this time, so it'll probably take
you QUITE a few tries to get this. Make sure to win the Mind's Eye before
continuing on; it's arguably the best accessory in the game. It will make the
areas on your Judgment Ring invisible, but it'll DOUBLE (yes, DOUBLE) your
physical attack! Paired with a Jade Lariat and weapons that have the Hit Area
widened on them, (or if you're just that good at Yuri's ring) Yuri becomes
ridiculously overpowered. If you don't win it, reload your last save and try
again. Remember, you need to win something from each member at least once!

If you talk to the Silent Peddler here, you'll find out that he also is a
Tight-lipped Merchant with goods for sale! Most notably, he has the Zodiac and
Cosmic Bracelets; the Zodiac Bracelet renders Paralysis and Petrification
ineffectual, and the Cosmic Bracelets renders Poison, Silence, and Confusion
ineffectual. These are two very useful accessories that you may want to buy if
you have the spare cash!

When you're ready, head north to the next area within the fortress. Open the
chest beside the stairs to the north for a [_MANA ROOT_], then go up the stairs
and north to the next area. You'll be at a fork, having to choose to go up two
different sets of stairs. Go up the eastern stairs first, following the path to
the ground. Make your way toward the set of stairs on the right side of the
room, but before going up, go behind them on the back side to find a chest
containing an awesome weapon for Yuri: the [_HAND NEEDLE_]. Equip it
immediately!

Go up the stairs and to the next screen, and in this bloody room, go up the
ladder in the eastern corner; you'll find a [_FACE GUARD_] to the left up here.
Once you have that, descend the ladder and check the table at the bottom of the
screen to find the [_WUGUI ROOM KEY_]. Leave this room the way you entered, and
continue back one more screen to the original fork with two sets of stairs.

Head north and take the western stairs now, continue west to the next area,
climb the stairs here to the next, then enter the door when you reach the path
blocked by a striped gate. Look on the floor to the left near the westernmost
barrel to find a [_SEAL OF THE SOUL_], then move up and right through the next
door to be on the other side of the striped gate. Open the chest to your
southeast for a [_THERA ROOT_], then go up the stairs here to the next area.

Get the [_PURE ROOT_] out of the chest here in the stairwell, then continue up
to the next screen. Move southwest and cross the bridge, opening the chest on
the other side for a [_SOUL BENEDICTION_]. Just above it to the left of the
bridge is either a urinal or a water fountain or something... who knows. In any
case, examine it to find another [_LOTTERY TICKET_]. That's it for treasure, so
go up the stairs to the west and save your game here.

  NOTE     Make sure to equip Leonardo's Bears before entering Wugui's room!

|        | Raging Tiger      |                   |                   |        |
|        | Inferno           |                   |                   |        |
|        '———————————————————'———————————————————'———————————————————'        |
|                                                                             |
|  This is basically the same battle as with Yamaraja: War, only easier. As   |
|  with Yamaraja: War, the Cursed Puppet will absorb all magic, making        |
|  Zhuzhen useful only as a healer. He also uses the Game of Death, just as   |
|  usual; if you don't have those Leonardo's Bears equipped to everyone,      |
|  they'll have a chance to instantly kill you. His Nightmare attack will     |
|  hit the entire party for a lot of damage, so make sure heal afterward.     |
|  The only other thing he does is a hellacious physical attack that'll hit   |
|  for major damage. Once he starts using Nightmare repeatedly, you could be  |
|  in a bit of trouble.                                                       |
|                                                                             |
|  Have Yuri fuse into Inferno and cast Fighting Spirit on himself, followed  |
|  by physically attacking Yamaraja every turn. If he has the Mind's Eye      |
|  equipped, it won't take very long. Margarete should be attacking           |
|  normally, but having her jump in to use Thera Seeds if needed, and         |
|  Zhuzhen should focus completely on recovery.                               |
|                                                                             |
|  If you're having trouble staying healed, have Yuri fuse into Heaven's      |
|  Fiend so you have the whole party healing spell.                           |
|                                                                             |
'——.—————————————————.——————————————————.—————————————————————————————————————'
    \   02000 EXP   / \   06000 Cash   /
     '—————————————'   '——————————————'

finished, and all of the monsters will be gone as well. That's it, so make your
way back to Shanghai.
```

```text
As I mentioned before, Mr. Zhen is now hosting pit fights! Just visit the bar
and go behind on the curtain at the top of the screen and talk to him. It costs
300 Cash to fight, and you'll have to fight 10 consecutive battles, with no
chance to heal between battles. There are 12 sets of enemies; the order is
random, and you'll only have to fight 10 of the 12 sets of enemies listed in
the Enemy Formations section above.

You'll want to fight with Yuri, as you get a special prize once you've beaten
all 10. Two-thirds of the enemy groups listed are pretty easy, however, these
four may give you trouble:


   Yamaraja: Wind
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
He's decently strong against physical attacks, so make sure that you're able to
cast Wind Shear with your Tornado Fusion to try and take him out quickly.


   Li Li
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
She's a pain just like before. Make sure you have something that prevents
Paralysis, or you're in for a rough battle. Other than that, some normal
physical attacks while fused should take her out rather quickly, especially if
you have the Mind's Eye equipped.


   Prototype Wind Shear
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
Unlike the weaklings from the beginning of the game, this guy means serious
business, and is as tough as a boss. It has the ability to inflict Judgment
Ring anomalies, but also casts Flaming Arm of Death, which can Silence you and
keep you from being able to use Fusion. Make sure that you heal every other
round with Thera Seeds to keep your HP up, because he can decimate of TON of it
in just two rounds, and stay in the Man Dragon Fusion to keep casting Flash
Flood in the rounds you're not healing. If you have the Mind's Eye equipped and
you're pretty successful at it, do that instead, as you'll inflict more damage.


   Custom Wind Shear
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
As with the Prototype Wind Shear, I hope you have the Pocket Watch equipped,
otherwise you're going to have a heck of a time hitting your ring. He is also
just as strong as his counterpart, easily of boss difficulty. Make sure that
you heal every other round with Thera Seeds to keep your HP up, because he can
decimate of TON of it in just two rounds, and stay in the Inferno Fusion to
keep casting Fireball in the rounds you're not healing. If you have the Mind's
Eye equipped and you're pretty successful at it, do that instead, as you'll
inflict more damage.

Taking into consideration all that the plethora of enemies here can do to you
(Paralysis, Ring anomalies, and Silence), I recommend having the following
setup:

       .———————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————.
       |                           Yuri [19]                           |
       |                                                               |
       |===============================================================|
       |                          Hand Needle                          |
       |                        Studded Harness                        |
       |                                                               |
       |   RosewoodBracelet  OR  Zodiac Bracelet ¯¯\  OR  Mind's Eye   |
       |      Bell Bracelet  OR  Cosmic Bracelet __/¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   |
       |                         Pocket Watch                          |
       |                                                               |
       |                          Man Dragon                           |
       |                            Inferno                            |
       |                            Tornado                            |
       '———————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————'

If you're comfortable with the Judgment Ring, even with anomalies on it, then I
recommend keeping the Mind's Eye on in place of one of the Bracelets. Paralysis
and Silence can easily be cured with an item. If you want to play it ultra-
safe, then don't worry about the Mind's Eye.

Once you've defeated a set of 10 enemies with Yuri, you'll receive
[_5000 CASH_], as well as a memento for Yuri, [_ANNE'S CROSS_].

  NOTE     If you're aiming to get a full Monster Library, then make sure that
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   you find both the Prototype and Custom Wind Shears before moving on.





=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=

That's it for side quests, so let's visit the final area in Asia, Kuihai Tower.
Make sure to SAVE before entering!

  NOTE     If you need a bit of extra cash, see the beginning of the next
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   section, where you can find a Third Key that you can sell.

  NOTE     Except for weapons / armor / caps / belts, which are assumed as
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   obvious missables as they are replaced by stronger versions, there
           are two pieces of equipment that you need to buy now if you ever
           plan on getting them, as they're only available in Asia. Once you
           finish Kuihai Tower, you'll never be able to get them again, so make
           sure to buy as many as you want/need NOW. These items are...

           - Brigand Earrings (Shanghai, Huayuan) (I recommend purchasing 6)
           - Pirate Earrings (Shanghai, Huayuan) (I recommend purchasing 5)
```

```text
Before climbing the stairs, open the visible chest on the stairs to the left
for a [_SEAL OF LIFE_], then open the second not-so-visible chest on the
opposite side for a [_THIRD KEY_]. If you wanted to buy something but was short
on cash, you now have an extra 15,000+ Cash available if you sell this, once
again.

Once you have both of those, start climbing the central staircase and attempt
to enter the Yawang Gate, where you'll have to take on another Yamaraja!

      .————————————.

|        | Western Belt      | Voodoo Doll       | Weird Bottle      |        |

|        | Raging Tiger      |                   |                   |        |
|        | Inferno           |                   |                   |        |
```
